div.div: 4 يُؤْجِمُ النَّاسَ , or النَّاسَ ↓ يُؤَجِّمُ , [accord. to different copies of the K, the former being the reading in the TA,] He makes men's own selves to be objects of dislike, disapprobation, or hatred, to them. (K voce أَجُومٌ.) [Accord. to the TK, you say, آجَمَهُ مِنْهُ, inf. n. إِيجَامٌ, meaning He made him to be an object of dislike, disapprobation, or hatred, to him.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
